steps.en: Install the skill and local rendering tools
steps.zh: 安装技能与本地渲染工具

steps.en: Supply narration, cleared assets and a visual direction
steps.zh: 提供口播、授权素材与视觉方向

steps.en: Write shots and build animated scenes or clip specifications
steps.zh: 编写分镜并构建动画场景或片段描述

steps.en: Render frames and measure the encoded film
steps.zh: 逐帧渲染并测量编码成片

steps.en: Watch the result and resolve visual problems
steps.zh: 观看结果并处理视觉问题

steps.en: Gate delivery and write measured notes beside the film
steps.zh: 检查交付门禁，随成片写实测说明

value.en: Editable animation plus measured delivery evidence, not just a verbal quality claim
value.zh: 得到可编辑动画与实测交付证据，不只口头保证
